title: Data to insights, visually driven.
text:
I create valuable data products that turn raw data into actionable intelligence and drive meaningful impact.

View my work Contact me











  
  
    Insightful analytics
    Transform raw data into actionable insights that guide smarter decisions across marketing, product, and business.
    
  
  
  
    Funnel optimization
    Spot drop-offs, identify growth levers, and design strategies that improve conversion at every stage of the user journey.
    
  
  
  
    Attribution & impact
    Understand which touchpoints drive results, measure ROI accurately, and optimize campaigns based on real data.
    
  
  
  
    Campaign performance
    Track and analyze multi-channel marketing campaigns to turn performance metrics into actionable strategy.
    
  
  
  
    Visual sensemaking
    Transforming raw data into stories you can see, understand, and act on.
